import numpy as np, itertools
one=np.ones_like(P)
basis={'1':one,'P':P,'P2':P**2,'P3':P**3,'iP':1/(1+P),'t':t,'t2':t**2,'tP':t*P,'tP2':t*P**2,'t2P':t**2*P,'t2P2':t**2*P**2,'t2iP':t**2/(1+P),'tiP':t/(1+P),'P4':P**4,'iP2':1/(1+P)**2,'exp_t':np.exp(-t),'sqrtt':np.sqrt(t)}
names=list(basis)
def score(sel):
    A=np.column_stack([basis[n] for n in sel])
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.mean((A@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt),c
best=[]
for k in range(3,8):
    res=[]
    for sel in itertools.combinations(names,k):
        s,_=score(sel); res.append((s,sel))
    res.sort()
    print(k,res[0][0],res[0][1])

cols=[];lab=[]
for i in range(5):
    for j in range(5):
        cols.append(Pn**i*tn**j); lab.append((i,j))

c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)

for (i,j),v in zip(lab,c): C[i,j]=v

print(np.linalg.svd(C,compute_uv=False).round(4))
